comments.body:
Confirmed independently and fixed. The CLI had applied Amazon's site allowlist to every platform.

`--sites` still selects Amazon sites, and invalid Amazon sites remain local errors. `--platform-sites` validates its JSON structure and lowercases site codes; other platforms no longer inherit Amazon's list. Their complete site coverage is not known locally and remains subject to API validation. A successful dry run is not a claim of server support.

The modified CLI was tested with one real P002 request on 2026-09-07: HTTP 200, `success=true`, exit 0, request ID `20260907134929-KoaSvneWa2zxWfn1`. All 8 returned records were `Tiktok / SG`. The actual response also passed an offline renderer replay. Estimated cost was 5 points; the billing ledger was not queried. No retries or feature-word management calls were made.

Regression coverage includes TikTok SG, mixed platforms, payload construction, invalid Amazon sites, malformed input rejected before authentication, and server-error propagation. All 34 local tests pass; the fix branch's Linux/Python 3.8, Windows/Python 3.12, and macOS/Python 3.14 CI checks were verified before merging.

See the [verification report](https://github.com/SuntekCorps-xLab/eric-compliance-suite/blob/main/reports/2026-09-07-issue-17-verification.md), [sanitized evidence](https://github.com/SuntekCorps-xLab/eric-compliance-suite/blob/main/reports/2026-09-07-issue-17-verification.json), and [updated platform validation documentation](https://github.com/SuntekCorps-xLab/eric-compliance-suite/blob/main/references/policy-detection.md). Only TikTok SG was verified live in this check; no complete TikTok site list or other platform support is inferred.
